method: Seeded distance-stratified sample: public address index records and simulated map selections offset 15–80m from distinct public addresses, paired with Taipei metro stations; equally stratified types and directions, not filtered by route connectivity. One fresh worker per case, current local product planner with ordinary walking profile and one fresh construction snapshot. Address points and map points may be inside buildings, private areas, water or other unavailable locations. Nearby alternatives are not selected. Success means only a route result to the selected coordinates and is not physical accessibility, official online routing, live GPS, or citywide success.
